summary: Validated CSS light-theme (ambiance-clarte) branding fix on MyExtension AI. Logged in as Thomas via login-guest-btn, toggled theme via ambiance-toggle-btn, verified CSS custom properties via getComputedStyle on .App, sampled visible text colors on cockpit /, /bien-etre and /pilotage, then re-toggled to dark and verified non-regression. All acceptance criteria PASS.
critical_code_review_comments: Preferences are persisted server-side (prefsApi.save) so theme survives reloads. This is fine but means a testing agent starting cold may land in whatever theme the previous session left. Tests should assert on class rather than assume starting theme.

Onboarding help modals ('Cockpit — mode d'emploi', 'Bien-être — mode d'emploi', 'Pilotage — mode d'emploi') can appear on first navigation to a route in a session. They do not affect the CSS token fix but can block force-clicks; regular Playwright .click() works fine.
test_credentials: Login via green 'Ouvrir le compte test (Thomas)' button (data-testid=login-guest-btn) on /login. No password.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Light theme (.ambiance-clarte) now correctly overrides --app-bg/--app-text/--app-surface/--app-border/--app-accent (navy #14213d text on ivory #F6F2EA). Verified via getComputedStyle and visible text sampling on cockpit '/', '/bien-etre' and '/pilotage'. Dark mode (--app-text=#F1F5F9, --app-bg=#0B1F3A) fully intact after re-toggle. Note: theme choice is persisted through backend prefs, so successive test runs may start in different themes — always assert on the '.App' className rather than assuming initial state, and toggle to the expected state first.
